messages.S1・S2で呼吸回数を貯め、S3「舞い散る紅梅」のマッチ勝利で呼吸に変え、クリテ: Build Poise Count with S1 and S2, convert it into Poise by winning a clash with S3 Red Plum Blossoms Scatter, then rapidly stack 10 Red Plum Blossom through critical hits to inflict Slash Fragility. She struggles to build the Poise needed for critical hits alone and relies on support such as a Blade Lineage team.
messages.S3「舞い散る紅梅」(本領): Ⅰ・Ⅱコインのクリティカル的中時にそれぞれ紅梅5: **S3 — Red Plum Blossoms Scatter (core)**: On Critical Hit, Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each inflict 5 Red Plum Blossom. Critical Hits from this skill do not reduce Red Plum Blossom, so if both Coins crit, it reaches 10. A Critical Hit while the target has 10 Red Plum Blossom inflicts 1 Slash Fragility. On Clash Win, halves her Poise Count and gains Poise equal to the amount lost, up to 10. Gains +1 Coin Power for every 7 Poise she has, up to 3.
messages.紅梅: 最大10の特殊出血。メインターゲットへのクリティカル発動確率+10%(数: **Red Plum Blossom**: A special Bleed with a maximum of 10. Gives +10% Critical chance against the main target, regardless of its value. When the bearer takes Critical damage, it gains Bleed equal to half the value and takes (value×3)% more Critical damage. Decreases by 1 each time the bearer takes damage.
messages.呼吸の準備: S1「月下剣舞」・S2「刺法」は使用時に呼吸回数+2。呼吸(威力): **Preparing Poise**: S1 Moonlit Blade Dance and S2 Acupuncture each add +2 Poise Count on use. Her only source of Poise Potency is about 1 from Coin Ⅱ of S1 on Heads Hit. Critical chance is "5×Poise"%, so she depends on Poise from outside.
messages.外部からの呼吸: 剣契殺手 ドンキホーテはS2のクリティカル的中時に、呼吸が最も: **External Poise**: Don Quixote's Blade Lineage Salsu gives 2 Poise, or 2 more for a Blade Lineage member, to the ally with the least Poise when S2 lands a Critical Hit.
messages.バトルパッシブ「梅が如く咲き出でる血」(傲慢×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): クリ: **Combat passive — Sanguine Plum Blossoms (4 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On Critical Hit, inflicts 1 Red Plum Blossom, up to 3 times/unlimited. At 10 Red Plum Blossom, inflicts 1 Defense Level Down instead, up to 6 times.
messages.剣契組織員などから呼吸をもらいつつ、S1・S2で呼吸回数を貯める。S3でマッチに: Receive Poise from Blade Lineage members and similar allies while building Poise Count with S1 and S2. Winning a Clash with S3 turns half of that Count into Poise and makes Critical Hits more likely. 10 Red Plum Blossom and Slash Fragility raise the damage of subsequent Slash attacks, so she is likely most effective when acting before allied Slash attackers. Paired with Meursault's Blade Lineage Mentor, her S1 becomes a strong damage source, but outside Blade Lineage teams and Mirror Dungeons she struggles to perform.
